firmware/b4q/Makefile.note: host builds only (twin, host, xcheck) into the top-level ignored build/; no image.

firmware/b4q/b4q_data.h.note: the write set and the loaded image's frames (builds/b4/b4.bit at b4_build.json's digest); held equal to a fresh generation.

firmware/b4q/b4q_data.json.note: the reviewable record of the write set, the base frame digests and the stale-manifest finding.

firmware/b4q/b4q_derive.c.note: DERIVED: sha256 / hex / CRC / frame ECC / stream builder and parser / frames hash / readback and cleanup commands / nonce step VERBATIM (tests/test_b4q_derive.py holds each function's text); the genome codec rewritten for 21 bits in one word; base64url and the identity page removed (unused).

firmware/b4q/b4q_derive.h.note: DERIVED: the counts (8 target frames, 2 envelopes, 21 genome bits, 1 word); the identity-page and base64 declarations removed.

firmware/b4q/b4q_hal.h.note: the five calls through which the transaction logic reaches the outside world (MMIO read / write, the notary, the event sink).

firmware/b4q/b4q_host_main.c.note: the line protocol on stdin / stdout to host/b4q_session.py and the command loop; not a board image.

firmware/b4q/b4q_regmap.h.note: from host/b4carrier_regmap.py, the one register table of record.

firmware/b4q/b4q_tx.c.note: the transaction logic: the allowlist at the accessor, bounded polls of STATUS / FAULT, the four legal DMA transactions, link 2 / link 3, fail-closed stops; derived nothing from firmware/b1/b1_app.c textually — the same discipline (the DMA tuples, the sentinel prefill, the link-2 re-read, the settle condition) re-expressed for the v2 register map. Repair of 2026-10-27 (R1): the pre-event readback compared to the signed candidate before the init event, the post-event to the pre-event before the steps, the restored base to the derived base before the restore event; every write response propagated (a refused STEP_IN launches no STEP).

firmware/b4q/b4q_tx.h.note: the session opening and the transaction (P1-P10, A5 J2 / J3) on the carrier v2 register map; the result structs.

firmware/b4q/build.sh.note: make host + twin and the build record (compiler path / version / flags / binary digests) in build/b4q_firmware/build.json.

scope: firmware/b4q: the B4Q executing side, host-built; nothing cross-compiled into an image (a compile-only check of the pure units with the pinned cross toolchain is in the Makefile)
source: firmware/b1 (the B1 image's pure units, themselves copied from zynq-psoracle 689dde1 per firmware/b1/IMPORT.json)
